headlines.title: On the ground in Texas, Michigan and Maine: Voters speak out at polls on key Senate races
headlines.description: NBC News' Gadi Schwartz reports from Texas, Stephanie Gosk checks in from Michigan and Monica Alba has the latest from Maine on Election Day.

headlines.title: Troy Jackson defeats GOP Sen. Susan Collins in Maine, padding Democrats’ majority
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Jackson, who became the Democratic nominee after an embattled Graham Platner dropped out, flipped control of the Senate seat.

headlines.title: Democrats win control of the House of Representatives with a vow to combat Trump
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Democrats will take control of the House next year, giving them the power to investigate Trump and advance legislation to check his policies.

headlines.title: Gadi Schwartz checks in live with NBC News team stationed across the U.S.
headlines.description: Gadi Schwartz reports live from Texas on election night and goes behind the scenes with NBC News correspondents in other key battlegrounds across the country as they hear from voters on the issues closest to home.

headlines.title: Candidates speak amid 2026 midterm election results
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as candidates in state races across the country deliver remarks to their supporters as results from the 2026 midterm elections are determined.

headlines.title: Democrat Sherrod Brown unseats Sen. Jon Husted in Ohio, completing comeback bid
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Brown, who lost a re-election bid in 2024, will return to the Senate after he defeated Husted, a Republican who was appointed to succeed JD Vance.

headlines.title: Democrat James Talarico turns Texas Senate seat blue, defeating Ken Paxton
headlines.description: Talarico has made history in Texas, notching a Democratic Senate victory there for the first time since 1988, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Josh Turek flips Iowa Senate seat, giving Democrats a boost in the fight for the majority
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Turek, a state lawmaker, has defeated GOP Rep. Ashley Hinson in a state that has trended red in recent years.

headlines.title: Democrat Annie Andrews defeats GOP Sen. Darline Graham in South Carolina, a major upset
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Graham failed to secure a full term after she was appointed to the seat held by her late brother.

headlines.title: Democrat Adam Hamilton pulls off upset over GOP Sen. Roger Marshall in Kansas
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Hamilton, a pastor and former Republican, will become the first Democrat to win a Senate seat in deep red Kansas since 1932.
